tail_derivation.rule: for s in (2,3,4,5): for i in 2..7: for (c,d) in itertools.combinations(1..7, 2): a = vars[json.dumps(['g',s,[0,c],[i,0]])], b = vars[json.dumps(['g',s,[0,d],[i,0]])]; clause = tuple(sorted((-a,-b))); line = '%d %d 0\n' % clause (ASCII, LF)
